permissions_prewarm._meta: CX-14 Section E1 (2026-05-23) + CX-17 (2026-05-23): log-line strings emitted by PermissionsPrewarmer + customer-facing intro screen copy shown BEFORE the pre-warm fires. install_failed_banner._meta: CX-14 Section E2 (2026-05-23): split into a minimal top banner (title only) and a rich body pane. The previous design crammed the heading + subtitle + four buttons into a single horizontal banner; the buttons wrapped on the 880pt window and the subtitle 'Something went wrong... Try again' read as a single throwaway sentence. The split surfaces the rich apology + next-step copy in the right pane (where the customer is already looking) while the top banner stays as a quiet always-visible failure marker. The 'Try again' button was dropped: terminating the app and asking the customer to re-launch is more reliable than an in-place restart, and the Quit option in the footer already does the same thing. support@ostler.ai is now hyperlinked inline via AttributedString rather than living in a separate 'Email support' label.

consent_third_party._meta: CX-18 (Studio retest #13, 2026-05-23): Q19 third-party-data acknowledgement was rendering as a wall of equal-weight body text with 'Legal note:' buried mid-paragraph and no visual separation between the customer-facing explanation and the GDPR fine-print. The SwiftUI view now overrides the default help-text render with two Text() views: a primary intro_body in standard body copy + a subordinated legal_note in smaller italic with reduced contrast. Bash-side MSG_PROMPT_CONSENT_THIRD_PARTY_HELP keeps the full text for TTY installs; the GUI uses these split strings instead. docs.ostler.ai/privacy/third-party-data link rendering is handled by the existing linkifyHelpText() Markdown post-processor.
consent_third_party.intro_body:
Any data you import from third parties (Google Takeout, Meta downloads, LinkedIn exports, etc.) stays on this Mac. Ostler stores it in your local knowledge graph; nothing leaves your device.

By continuing you understand and agree that you are solely responsible for the processing and keeping of this data on your machine, just like the email messages already on your hard drive.
consent_third_party.legal_note: Legal note: For records you import to this Mac, you are the data controller and processor under UK and EU law (UK GDPR Article 4(7) and 4(8)). Creative Machines never receives this data and is not the controller. Your processing for personal and household purposes falls within UK/EU GDPR Article 2(2)(c). Read more at docs.ostler.ai/privacy/third-party-data.

consent_article_9._meta: EU/UK Article-9 special-category consent (install.sh region==eu branch, gui_read id=consent_article_9). Bash-side MSG_PROMPT_CONSENT_ARTICLE_9_HELP is only a one-line summary, so before this entry the GUI rendered just that line while the full special-category disclosure was echoed to stdout and filtered out of the window -- a compliance gap. The SwiftUI view now overrides the default help-text render exactly like consent_third_party: a primary intro_body in standard body copy + a subordinated legal_note in smaller italic with reduced contrast. Wording mirrors legal/consent_strings.py (ARTICLE_9_EU_CONSENT, v1.1-2026-07-15) reflowed for the GUI medium: the TTY-only 'Your decision' [Y]/[N] block and the 'click Read the Privacy Policy below' button reference are omitted because the GUI carries a yes/no toggle + Continue instead. The ostler.ai/privacy reference stays plain text (linkifyHelpText only auto-links https:// and docs.ostler.ai/... substrings).
consent_article_9.intro_body:
One last thing – what Ostler will look at on your Mac

Ostler is a personal assistant, so it works by looking at the parts of your life you keep on this Mac. Some of that is sensitive. UK and EU privacy law requires us to ask you, in clear words, before we touch any of it.

Where the data lives. Everything Ostler reads stays on this Mac, in encrypted folders only you can unlock. We never get a copy. There is no "cloud" version of your data.

What's in scope. Depending on which connectors you turn on, Ostler may process the following kinds of information that the law treats as "special category" data:

- Health information that you mention in emails, messages, calendar entries or transcribed conversations
- Religious or philosophical beliefs mentioned in any of the above
- Sexual orientation mentioned in any of the above
- Trade union membership
- Voice - labelling *who* is speaking on calls (speaker identification). This is done only by the optional Ostler iOS app, on your iPhone, under a separate consent screen in that app - not on this Mac. This Mac never receives voice captures or voice fingerprints. (We do not infer mood, emotion, sentiment, stress or deception from voice.)
- Mentions of criminal offences – your own or other people's – in any of the above

We do not perform emotion recognition. If that ever changes we will ask you again, separately, on a new consent screen.

The categories above are processed on this Mac and stay on it - the one exception is voice speaker-identification, which happens only on your iPhone (as noted above) and never reaches this Mac. None of it is sent to Creative Machines or to any third party, except in the specific cases listed in our Privacy Policy at ostler.ai/privacy (mainly: optional cloud routing for non-personal questions, software update checks, and a handful of public metadata services).

You can change your mind any time. You can:

- turn individual connectors (email, calendar, WhatsApp, etc.) off in Settings, which stops Ostler reading that source
- delete everything Ostler has stored using "Reset Ostler" in the menu
- completely uninstall Ostler using the uninstaller at ~/Documents/Ostler/Uninstall Ostler.app

Withdrawing consent stops processing from that point forward. It does not undo work Ostler already did with your earlier consent.
consent_article_9.legal_note: Legal note: You are the data controller for all special-category data Ostler processes on this Mac (UK GDPR Article 4(7)). Creative Machines never receives any of this data. Your explicit consent above (UK GDPR Article 9(2)(a)) is the lawful basis for processing. For personal and household use, Article 2(2)(c) further limits scope. This consent is revocable at any time without affecting processing that has already taken place.

consent_spoken_capture._meta: BW3-8 (box-walk-v4, 2026-07-24): the spoken-audio recording-consent screen (gui_read id=consent_spoken_capture) had NO dedicated SwiftUI renderer, so the whole MSG_PROMPT_CONSENT_SPOKEN_CAPTURE_HELP blob -- intro + a 'What we ask of you' bullet list + the 'Legal note:' fine-print -- fell through to the generic single-Text() help path and rendered as one 14pt run with the bullets and the legal note mashed into the same paragraph flow, no block separation, no subordinated legal styling. This split copy powers a dedicated consentSpokenCaptureBody() that mirrors consent_third_party / consent_article_9 (primary intro_body + subordinated italic legal_note) but adds a real bulleted 'What we ask of you' list. Bash-side MSG_PROMPT_CONSENT_SPOKEN_CAPTURE_HELP is unchanged so the TTY install path still renders the full text inline.
consent_spoken_capture.intro_body: Ostler can turn spoken audio you capture – calls and meetings – into searchable text. Typing and messaging are unaffected. Getting any consent the law requires is your responsibility, not ours.
consent_spoken_capture.bullet_1: Obtain whatever consent your local law requires before you capture a spoken conversation.
consent_spoken_capture.bullet_2: Make it clear to the people you are with that audio is being captured – say so, or keep a visible indicator on.
consent_spoken_capture.bullet_3: If in doubt, leave this off. You can turn it on later in Settings.
consent_spoken_capture.legal_note: Legal note: Rules on recording people speaking vary by country – in some places (Germany and France, for example) everyone taking part must agree first. Ostler transcribes on your devices and never keeps or sends the audio, but you still need consent where your local law requires it. Recording the spoken word can be regulated by national law in its own right – for example section 201 of the German Criminal Code (Verletzung der Vertraulichkeit des Wortes) or Article 226-1 of the French Penal Code – independently of data-protection law. As the person making the recording on this Mac, you are responsible for compliance. Creative Machines never receives your recordings and is not a party to them.

recovery_key_reveal._meta: CX-53 (DMG ship, 2026-05-24): recovery-key reveal sheet rendered over InstallCompleteView when install.sh emits the RECOVERY_KEY marker. Mirrors install.sh.strings.en-GB.sh MSG_INFO_RECOVERY_KEY_REVEALED_* keys so the GUI + TTY paths read from a single editorial source.
recovery_key_reveal.heading: 你的復原密鑰
recovery_key_reveal.body: 請現在抄下或列印出來。如果你忘記密碼短語，而且無法存取「鑰匙圈」，這是唯一能重新進入的方法。Ostler 無法為你找回密鑰 – 密鑰只會保留在這部 Mac 上，不會儲存在任何伺服器。
recovery_key_reveal.confirm_label: 我已將它存放在安全的地方
recovery_key_reveal.copied_announcement: 復原密鑰已拷貝到剪貼板

pair_iphone._meta: CX-56 (DMG ship, 2026-05-24): iOS Companion pairing QR section rendered between the service tick list and the CTA buttons on InstallCompleteView. The Hub gateway exposes POST http://localhost:8000/admin/paircode (no auth needed on localhost) which returns a §3.3 envelope JSON; we render that JSON string as a 256x256 QR with an oxblood border. CM031 iOS app scans the QR + decodes the envelope.
pair_iphone.title: 已經安裝了 app？
pair_iphone.help: 你的 iPhone 上已有 Ostler app 嗎？掃描此代碼即可與這部 Mac 配對。你亦可稍後在 app 內進行配對。
pair_iphone.fetch_failed: 暫時無法連接 Ostler 閘道。它可能仍在啟動中 – 請按「重新整理」再試一次。
pair_iphone.fetch_refused: Ostler 閘道拒絕了配對要求，因此重新整理也沒有幫助。Ostler 已安裝完成：請開啟 Ostler，改為在 app 內配對。（閘道傳回 {code}。）
pair_iphone.fetch_unexpected: Ostler 閘道已回應，但沒有提供配對碼。你可以再按「重新整理」試一次，或稍後在 app 內配對。（閘道傳回 {code}。）
pair_iphone.fetch_empty: Ostler 閘道傳回空白的配對碼。你可以再按一次「重新整理」，或稍後在 App 內配對。
pair_iphone.fetch_unreadable: Ostler 閘道已回應，但無法讀取配對碼。你可以稍後在 App 內配對。（{reason}）

get_ios_app._meta: #599 (2026-06-02): success-screen 'Get Ostler on your iPhone' section. Static QR + link to https://ostler.ai/ios, a stable redirect Andy repoints to the App Store listing once it is live, so the DMG never needs recutting for the store URL. This is the primary iPhone call to action; the pair_iphone QR is demoted below it.
get_ios_app.title: 在 iPhone 上取得 Ostler
get_ios_app.body: 掃描此代碼以下載 Ostler App，然後開啟它，即可隨時隨地使用你的 Wiki 和助理。

install_complete._meta: #599 (2026-06-02): completion screen reworked. Hero 'Ostler is installed' (calm, not 'everything is ready') -> a 'what's happening now' hydration explainer that is the focus -> 'Get Ostler on your iPhone' (get_ios_app) -> demoted pairing QR (pair_iphone) -> the per-service tick list moved into a collapsed 'Hub status' disclosure. CTAs sit in the sticky footer. All copy via Rule 0.9. Qualitative hydration timing only (no hard hours number).
install_complete.heading: Ostler 已安裝
install_complete.subheading: Ostler 已在這部 Mac 上設定完成。
install_complete.hydration_body: Ostler 正在背景建立你的私人知識庫。第一輪可能需要數小時，而且隨著它持續運作，你的 Wiki 和助理會愈來愈豐富。你可以關閉此視窗，它會自行繼續。
install_complete.hub_status_caveat: 這些內容是安裝程式執行時所記錄的，並非對你的 Mac 作即時檢查。剔號表示該步驟當時回報成功，並不代表 Ostler 剛剛重新檢查過。
install_complete.wiki_signin_hint: 你的 Wiki 位於 Ostler 內。此按鈕會在其中開啟，並已自動登入，無需輸入任何內容。
install_complete.wiki_checking: 正在檢查你的 Wiki 是否已準備好。
install_complete.wiki_not_serving_label: 你的 Wiki 仍在建立中
install_complete.wiki_not_serving_body: Ostler 暫時未能連接你的 wiki，所以按鈕已停用，免得帶你到一個載入不到的頁面。wiki 會在背景自行建立，通常幾分鐘內就會出現。你可以先打開上面的 Ostler，wiki 到時就會準備好；或者稍後在「Wiki」側邊欄再看看。
install_complete.auto_quit_note: 此安裝程式很快會自動關閉。上面的所有項目不需要它也會繼續運作。
install_complete.keep_installer_help: 保留後，你可以再次執行它來修復或更新 Ostler，而無需重新下載任何內容。取消剔選的話，此視窗關閉時會將它移到垃圾桶。
install_complete.memory_ceiling_body: 此安裝程式使用了異常大量的記憶體。安裝本身已經完成。如果你的 Mac 曾警告應用程式記憶體不足，不會有任何資料遺失，重新執行安裝程式是安全的。

tailscale_connect._meta: CX-81 Tailscale step (2026-05-26): dedicated full-screen 'Connect your iPhone and Watch' view rendered by TailscaleConnectView.swift, dispatched from OnboardingQuestionView when prompt.id == 'tailscale_connect'. Pairs with install.sh §3.15 STEP_BEGIN of the same id. Two big buttons (setup / skip) plus a collapsible mini-FAQ.
tailscale_connect.heading: 連接你的 iPhone 和 Apple Watch
tailscale_connect.body:
Tailscale 會為這部 Mac 提供一個穩定的私人位址，讓你的 iPhone 和 Apple Watch 無論身在何處都能連接：全程加密，不會公開暴露，個人使用免費。

如果沒有它，你 iPhone 上的 Ostler app 只能在你使用家中 Wi-Fi 時連接這部 Mac。
tailscale_connect.setup_button_sub: 大約需要一分鐘，我們會打開 Tailscale，並等你登入。
tailscale_connect.skip_button_sub: 你隨時可以在「設定」中回到這裏。
tailscale_connect.faq_what_a: Tailscale 是一項免費服務，可以在你自己的裝置之間建立一個小型私人網絡。你的 iPhone、Apple Watch 和這部 Mac 會獲得只有它們才能使用的私人位址，不會向公共互聯網公開任何內容。
tailscale_connect.faq_secure_a: 是的。你裝置之間的所有流量都以 WireGuard 進行端對端加密。Tailscale 本身永遠無法讀取你的資料 – 它只是協助你的裝置互相找到對方。
tailscale_connect.faq_later_a: 可以。你可以用 --repair 再次執行安裝程式，或在 Ostler 內打開「設定」，然後開啟 Tailscale。

whatsapp_link.step2: 選擇「連結裝置」，然後選擇「改用電話號碼連結」。

whatsapp_link.failed: Ostler 暫時無法從 WhatsApp 取得代碼。請確認這部 Mac 已連線上網，然後再試一次。
whatsapp_link.linked: WhatsApp 已連接。Ostler 現在可以在該處傳訊息給你。
